name: curatorr
description: Pick tonight's movie from your Radarr library.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.dev:demo: concurrently -k -n server,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev:demo -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w web && npm run build -w server
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p shared --noEmit && tsc -p server --noEmit && tsc -p web --noEmit && tsc -p web/tsconfig.node.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --noEmit
